Open research questions

These questions are recorded research gaps, not legal conclusions.

  • Scope of public service sites and whether annex language establishes a binding legal obligation need legal review. (AE-01)
  • Whether separate built-in text-to-speech is mandatory or technology-neutral alternatives satisfy the requirement is not resolved. (AE-02)
  • It is unclear which user journeys, media types and service channels require each feature. (AE-03)
  • Legal force and relation to binding digital government rules remain unverified. (SA-01)
  • Verify the exact clause and version in the primary guideline before encoding an obligation. (SA-02)
  • Exact applicability, exceptions and current standing relative to a later policy require authority confirmation. (QA-11-01)
  • A website-only WCAG rule cannot represent kiosks, telecommunications or broadcasting accessibility. (QA-11-02)
  • The terms where possible and where applicable require a published decision process; cannot be reduced to an unconditional Boolean. (QA-25-01)
  • No effective date or triggering enactment confirmed; do not calculate compliance deadlines from publication date. (QA-25-02)
  • Scope is ministry-specific; do not generalize to all UAE organizations. (AE-MOE-ACCESSIBILITY-01)
  • Legacy-content exception has no documented sunset or objective decision criteria in this record. (AE-MOE-ACCESSIBILITY-02)
  • The use of an accessibility overlay does not establish WCAG conformance. (AE-MOE-ACCESSIBILITY-03)
  • The source does not establish the precise WCAG version/level. (AE-MOF-ACCESSIBILITY-01)
  • Agency pledge should not be conflated with national legal enforceability. (AE-MOF-ACCESSIBILITY-02)
  • "To the extent possible" does not identify an objective threshold. (SA-MEP-ACCESSIBILITY-01)
  • The adopted WCAG conformance level is deferred to competent authorities. (SA-MEP-ACCESSIBILITY-02)
  • External linked platforms are excluded from the ministry policy scope. (SA-MEP-ACCESSIBILITY-03)
  • Confirm applicability to government agencies, technical standards, exemptions and whether later policies supersede the 2022 instrument. (om-national-digital-accessibility)
  • Capture policy and determine accessibility-specific provisions and scope. (jo-digital-inclusion-2025)
  • Identify accessibility and implementation provisions and later implementing instruments. (ma-disability-97-13)
  • Locate gazetted Arabic law and implementing regulations; do not derive website mandates from secondary summary. (eg-disability-law-10-2018)
  • Distinguish ministry claim of WCAG 2.1 AA from independent testing and national requirements. (bh-government-web-accessibility-example)
